listing.eventDescription: One Craigslist listing with title, price, posted date, category, area and neighborhood, coordinates, bedrooms and sqft (housing), pay, job title and employer (jobs), photo links and URL. A search with no results is free.

listing_detail.eventDescription: The same listing plus its full description, attributes, street address and update time, read from the posting page. Only with Full description on; charged instead of Listing, not on top of it.
